description: Edit ONE block of a note's body, addressed by the `block_id` (stable_id) from read_note. Ops: replace, insert (payload.new_raw + payload.position before|after|child_of), delete, split (payload.offset), merge (payload.second_id), indent, outdent. REQUIRES `expected_digest` from read_note — the write is classified against it with a four-way conflict contract: "clean" (disk unchanged), "disk_changed_elsewhere" (file moved but your block is intact — write it by passing on_conflict:"allow_untouched_block"), "block_changed" (your block also changed; the error body carries `disk_raw` so you can rebase) or "block_gone". block_changed and block_gone NEVER write. Echo `base_block` {index, count, kind, raw} from the read_note response to get the full classification on a document that moved; omit it and an unresolvable target reports block_gone. replace and delete are REFUSED on task-line blocks — use update_task / complete_task / delete_task so dialect + lint validation still apply. Frontmatter is out of jurisdiction. dry_run:true returns the resulting content WITHOUT writing.

anyOf.description:
The target block's state at read time, echoed from a prior
`read_note`. OPTIONAL: needed only to classify a conflict on a
document that CHANGED since it was read. Omit it and an unresolvable
target reports `block_gone` rather than risking a wrong-block write.

count.description: The document's block count at read time (`blocks.length`).

kind.description: The block's `kind` tag at read time.

base_block.description:
The target block's state at read time — unlocks the full four-way
conflict classification when the document changed.

block_id.description: The target block's `stable_id`, from a prior `read_note`.

dry_run.description:
Preview only — report the resulting whole-file content WITHOUT
writing. The response carries `dry_run: true`.

expected_digest.description:
The `content_digest` from the `read_note` that produced
`block_id`. REQUIRED — note-body writes are always
compare-and-swap guarded.

on_conflict.description:
What may proceed when the file changed since `expected_digest`:
`"abort"` (default) or `"allow_untouched_block"`. `block_changed`
and `block_gone` are refused under both.

op.description:
The block operation: one of `replace`, `insert`, `delete`,
`split`, `merge`, `indent`, `outdent`. `replace` and `delete` are
REFUSED on task-line blocks — use `update_task` / `complete_task`
/ `delete_task` so dialect and lint validation still apply.

payload.description: The op's operands. Required fields vary by `op`.

offset.description:
Character offset (Unicode scalar values, not bytes) within the
target block's `raw` (`split`). Identical for ASCII;
`mutate.rs::split_offset_counts_chars_not_bytes` pins the
non-ASCII behavior.

position.description:
Placement relative to the target block (`insert`): `"before"`,
`"after"` (default) or `"child_of"`.

second_id.description: The block immediately AFTER the target, merged into it (`merge`).

name: patch_note_block
